import inspect, json, hashlib, gc, torch
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch
import pagedcore.attention as attention
from scripts import diagnose_paged_decode as diagnostic
import pytest

torch.set_num_threads(1)
source = inspect.getsource(attention._multi_page_value_sum)
paired = source.replace('def _multi_page_value_sum(', 'def _paired_value_sum(').replace('range(4)', 'range(2)').replace('length % 4', 'length % 2').replace('position % 4', 'position % 2').replace('((partials[0] + partials[1]) + partials[2]) + partials[3]', 'partials[0] + partials[1]')
assert paired != source and 'partials[3]' not in paired
exec(compile(paired, '<paired-value-reduction>', 'exec'), attention.__dict__)
with patch.object(attention, '_multi_page_value_sum', attention._paired_value_sum):
    report = diagnostic.run('cuda:0', steps=3)
    report['value_reduction'] = 'paired'
    report['runtime_override_source'] = paired
    Path('/kaggle/working/paired-t4.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2))
    print('PAIRED_DIAGNOSTIC', json.dumps({name:report['summaries'][name] for name in ['eager_attention','fixed_probabilities','integrated']}), flush=True)
    gc.collect(); torch.cuda.empty_cache()
    result = pytest.main(['tests/gpu/test_decoder_parity.py', '-k', 'test_pinned_paged_decode_on_t4', '-q', '--tb=short', '--junitxml=/kaggle/working/paired-t4-tests.xml'])
    print('PAIRED_TEST_EXIT', result, flush=True)
